_doc: PER-PROJECT metric-filters (multi-repo / multi-project breakdown). These are COMPANIONS
to the un-dimensioned a-class metrics, NOT replacements: the plain QuestionsReceived etc.
stay the cheap, dense, all-project ROLLUP (and what the alarms watch); these add a
projectId dimension so the dashboard can break the same signal down BY project.
WHY separate metric NAMES (…ByProject) instead of adding projectId to the existing ones:
a CloudWatch metric-filter with `dimensions` CANNOT also set defaultValue (mutually
exclusive — a dimensioned metric is inherently sparse) and emitting a dimension also
REMOVES the no-dimension aggregate. Keeping a distinct dimensioned metric preserves BOTH:
the dense rollup (existing) AND the per-project cut (here). Cost is bounded — only the few
highest-value KPIs are dimensioned, and projectId is low-cardinality (≤ ~10 projects).
Dashboards read these via SEARCH('{NS,projectId} MetricName="…ByProject"', …) so they
auto-discover projects without hardcoding ids. Sparse (no defaultValue) — for breakdown
panels, not alarms; alarms keep watching the dense un-dimensioned rollup.

metrics.name: QuestionsReceivedByProject
metrics.purpose: 提问量 by 项目（看板按项目分组用；汇总看无维度 QuestionsReceived）

metrics.purpose: 成功答数 by 项目

metrics.name: AnswerFailedByProject
metrics.purpose: 失败答数 by 项目（哪个项目答得差一眼看出）

metrics.name: AnswerLatencyMsByProject
metrics.purpose: 总延迟 by 项目（分位用 metric 扩展统计 p95/p99）

metrics.name: FirstTokenMsByProject
metrics.purpose: 首字延迟 by 项目（体感关键）
